sections.heading: Complete Cooling Tower Maintenance
paragraphs: Unplanned downtime is expensive and usually preventable. ICST handles everything from scheduled upkeep to emergency response, so your system keeps performing without disrupting production.

sections.heading: Routine Maintenance
paragraphs: Scheduled inspections, regular cleaning, and component checks catch wear and fouling before they cause a breakdown. Consistent servicing protects your investment and helps you avoid more extensive repairs later.

sections.heading: Emergency Repair & Disaster Recovery
paragraphs: When a tower goes down, every hour of downtime carries a cost. We diagnose the fault, repair or replace the failed component, and restore service, including after storm damage. See our cooling tower disaster recovery work.

sections.heading: Thermal & Performance Upgrades
paragraphs: If your tower runs but underperforms, we upgrade fill media, drift eliminators, fans, and controls to restore heat transfer and save energy. A thermal upgrade often costs less than a full replacement.

sections.heading: Warning Signs Your Cooling Tower Needs Service
paragraphs: Heat, humidity, and monsoon debris keep a Thai cooling tower under constant stress. Catching these early signs keeps a minor repair from becoming a major overhaul.

sections.heading: Rising Output Temperatures
paragraphs: A tower that cannot hold its design conditions usually has fouled fill, scale buildup, or failing heat-transfer components. This pushes up energy costs across every connected chiller.

sections.heading: Excess Water Loss
paragraphs: Water disappearing faster than expected usually points to worn seals, damaged fill, or a failing drift eliminator. It often signals a component close to failure.

sections.heading: Unusual Noise or Vibration
paragraphs: Noise or vibration from the cooling tower fan, gearbox, or bearings is an early sign of wear. These faults also raise power consumption, so never let them run to failure.

sections.heading: Scale and Biological Growth
paragraphs: Buildup on fill reduces airflow and cooling capacity. It also creates conditions where bacteria, including Legionella, can multiply, which makes it a safety issue too.

sections.heading: Our Cooling Tower Maintenance Checklist
paragraphs: A maintenance plan is only as good as what gets checked on site. Our technicians follow this standard on every visit:

bullets.text: Clean the cold water basin and remove sediment, scale, and debris
Lubricate fan motor bearings and check the drive for wear, vibration, or misalignment
Inspect fan blades, gearboxes, and belts for damage
Review water treatment logs and calibrate automated chemical feed systems
Inspect distribution piping, nozzles, and spray patterns for even coverage
Clean fill media, drift eliminators, and basin surfaces
Check structural members for corrosion, cracking, or fatigue, and document every finding

sections.heading: Recommended Maintenance Schedule
paragraphs: Most industrial towers in Thailand need attention at four intervals:
Frequency
What gets checked
Weekly
Water quality testing and chemical treatment adjustments
Monthly
Mechanical inspection of fans, motors, gearboxes, and drives
Quarterly
Structural checks for rust, plus fill and nozzle cleaning
Semi-annually
Full deep cleaning and replacement of worn components
We set your exact schedule during the first evaluation, based on tower type, water quality, and load.

sections.heading: Crossflow Systems
paragraphs: Water flows horizontally through the fill while air moves vertically. We service valves, piping, and controls to keep flows balanced.

sections.heading: Counterflow Systems
paragraphs: Water falls against upward-moving air. We resolve fouling, structural wear, and airflow restrictions that raise energy use.

sections.heading: Wet, Hybrid, and Dry Systems

sections.heading: Concrete Structures

sections.heading: What is cooling tower maintenance?
paragraphs: It is the ongoing inspection, cleaning, repair, and water treatment management that keeps a cooling tower at its designed efficiency and prevents unplanned breakdowns.

sections.heading: What’s included in a cooling tower maintenance checklist?
paragraphs: A proper visit covers basin cleaning, fill and drift eliminator inspection, fan and drive checks, nozzle inspection, and a review of water treatment dosing and logs.

sections.heading: Do cooling towers need regular servicing even if they seem to be running fine?
paragraphs: Yes. All cooling towers require routine care. Scale, fouling, and microbial growth build up gradually and often go unnoticed until a component fails. Preventive maintenance catches these issues while they are still inexpensive to fix.

sections.heading: How much does cooling tower maintenance cost in Thailand?
paragraphs: Cost depends on tower size, type, condition, and the maintenance required. We cannot give an accurate cost estimate without the specific details of your system, so we inspect on site first. The final price reflects the agreed scope, and the initial evaluation is free.

sections.heading: How long does a cooling tower repair or upgrade take?
paragraphs: Timelines depend on scope and parts availability. We aim to complete projects efficiently without sacrificing quality. During the monsoon, inclement weather can delay construction or repair work on site, so we build that into the plan.
